scripts.text:
[{0}]
This boy must be the one who Ktullanux tried to protect.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这个男孩一定是寒冰龙想要保护的人。

scripts.text: - The boy was frozen inside a giant ice pole, and he looks as if he is in sleep rather than dead. -
scripts.translation: - 男孩被冻在一根巨大的冰柱中，看起来像是在沉睡，而不是死亡。 -

scripts.text:
- You felt freezing as you come closer to the giant ice pole that held the boy within,
- but for some reason, you felt a mysterious power from the pole. -
scripts.translation:
- 当你靠近那根囚禁着男孩的巨大冰柱时，感到一阵刺骨的寒冷，
- 但不知为何，你从冰柱中感受到了一股神秘的力量。 -

scripts.text: - The boy appeared to be snowy white, and beautiful from the head to the toe. -
scripts.translation: - 男孩通体雪白，从头到脚都显得美丽动人。 -

scripts.text:
- You wondered why a young boy had to be confined within this isolated cave, -
- you instinctively knew that no mage in this world would be able to release him from the ice pole.
scripts.translation:
- 你想知道为什么一个年幼的男孩会被囚禁在这个与世隔绝的冰洞中，
- 你本能地知道，世界上没有任何魔法师能将他从冰柱中释放出来。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What happened to this boy?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这个男孩发生了什么事？

scripts.text:
^3131FFLoomin, the boy
trapped in the Ice Cave.^000000
Class: 1st
 
 
 
^333333The pope was born together
with a twin brother, a fair
skinned boy with pale skin
and silver blond hair. This
had never happened before
and presented a unique problem
 
High Priest Niren acted as
their maternity nurse and
came to Rachel, where the
twins were cared for by the
Priests. They all argued
over the boy's ultimate fate...
 
No one doubted that the boy
was spiritually powerful, but
was he a sacred complement to
his sister, or a great evil that
was in direct opposition to
her? It was a grueling debate
 
In the end, the High Priests
decided that the boy posed
a great risk to their society
People may not consider the
pope's birth as divine if they
knew she had a twin brother.
 
However, not wanting to fear
the wrath of the gods, the
High Priests did not kill the
boy. Instead, they sealed
him in the Ice Cave.
 
The High Priests made
a contract with Ktullanux,
a fearsome ice monster, to
guard the boy's prison, and
to insure that no one would.
scripts.translation:
^3131FF被囚禁在冰洞中的男孩，鲁敏。^000000
阶级：1级
 
 
 
^333333教皇有一个双胞胎兄弟，是个皮肤白皙、头发呈银金色的男孩。
这种情况从未发生过，也带来了一个前所未有的难题。
 
高祭司尼伦负责照料这对双胞胎，并来到拉赫，由牧师们照顾他们。
所有人都为男孩最终的命运争论不休...
 
没有人怀疑男孩拥有强大的灵性力量，但他究竟是与姐姐相辅相成的神圣存在，还是与她势不两立的邪恶力量？
这场争论令人心力交瘁。
 
最终，高祭司们认定男孩的存在会给他们的社会带来巨大风险。
如果人们知道教皇有一个双胞胎兄弟，可能就不会再认为她的降生是神迹。
 
然而，高祭司们害怕触怒诸神，没有杀死男孩，而是将他封印在冰洞中。
 
高祭司们与可怕的冰系魔物寒冰龙订下契约，让它看守囚禁男孩的牢笼，确保无人接近。

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
May Freya bless
you, and give you an
abundance of health,
wealth, joy, and happiness!
scripts.translation:
[市民]
愿芙蕾雅保佑你，赐予你健康、财富、喜悦和幸福！

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
Freya is the goddess of
love and beauty. Do you
think that if I pray hard
enough, she'll help me
get a really pretty girlfriend?
scripts.translation:
[市民]
芙蕾雅是爱与美的女神。
你说，只要我足够虔诚地祈祷，她会帮我找到一个特别漂亮的女朋友吗？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
I've never seen our pope
before, I hear that she has
silver blond hair and really
white skin. Daddy says that
only one girl is like that
in every generation.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
我从来没见过我们的教皇，听说她有银金色的头发，皮肤特别白。
爸爸说，每一代只有一个这样的女孩。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
My daddy says the pope is
very special to us because
she's Freya. I mean, Freya
is a goddess, but she also
becomes people like us to talk
to us. Well, just the priests...
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
爸爸说，教皇对我们来说很特别，因为她就是芙蕾雅。
我的意思是，芙蕾雅虽然是女神，也会变成我们这样的人，来和我们说话。
嗯，不过只和牧师们说话...

scripts.text:
[Girl]
I don't get it all,
but it sounds like
she's a secret princess.
Doesn't that sound so nice?
But when I tell that to Daddy,
he gets so mad at me! Oh, well.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
我不太明白，不过听起来她就像一位神秘的公主。
听着不是很美好吗？
可我一跟爸爸这么说，他就生气了！唉，算了。

scripts.text:
[Cheshrumnir Guard]
You are at Cheshrumnir,
the hallowed grounds occupied
by our pope, Freya's mortal
incarnation. In respect for
her Excellency, I expect you
to enter with a pious heart.
scripts.translation:
[切什鲁姆尼尔卫兵]
这里是瑟斯隆尼勒，是教皇居住的圣地。
她是芙蕾雅在人间的化身，希望你怀着虔诚之心进入，以示敬意。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
If you open this door, you
can go inside this house,
and live in one of the rooms!
Then, you can add your couches
and a bed, and all of your stuff!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
只要打开这扇门，就能进去，住在里面的房间里！
然后，你就可以把自己的沙发、床，还有所有东西都搬进来！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
All you gotta do is...
Ugh! Turn this knob
and... Grrrrah! Open
this door... But it's
almost impossible..
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你只要...唔！转动这个把手，然后...呜！打开这扇门...
可怎么都打不开...

scripts.text:
[Anku]
It's been so long
already! I can't find
Himuhimu! Hide-and-Seek
shouldn't take this long...
scripts.translation:
[安库]
都过了这么久，我还是找不到希姆希姆！
捉迷藏不应该玩这么久啊...

scripts.text:
[Anku]
Oh, I'm already hungry...
Himuhimu, come out so
we can go home and eat!
Himuhimu! I give up!
H-Himuhimu...?
scripts.translation:
[安库]
啊，我都饿了...
希姆希姆，出来吧，我们回家吃饭！
希姆希姆！我认输！
希...希姆希姆...？

scripts.text:
[Himuhimu]
Zzzz...Z...
Anku, you'll never
find m... never find
me here... Zzzzz...
... So hungry...
scripts.translation:
[希姆希姆]
呼呼...呼...
安库，你永远找不...永远找不到躲在这里的我...
呼呼呼...
...好饿...

scripts.text:
[Rachel Guard]
Welcome to Rachel
the capital of Arunafeltz.
Please ask our guide
at the center of the city
for information and
guest services.
scripts.translation:
[拉赫卫兵]
欢迎来到阿鲁纳菲兹的首都拉赫。
如需咨询或使用游客服务，请找市中心的向导。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Priest]
Bwahahaha! Somehow,
drinks taste much better
during work hours!
scripts.translation:
[拉赫牧师]
哇哈哈！不知道为什么，上班时喝的酒就是特别好喝！

scripts.text:
[Airship Guide]
The Schwarzwald Republic's
international Airship service
for Arunafeltz can only be
accessed in Rachel. Please
follow the mark on your
Mini-Map to find the Airport.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇向导]
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的国际飞空艇在阿鲁纳菲兹境内只停靠拉赫。
请沿着小地图上的标记前往机场。

scripts.text:
[Freya's Follower]
All of Arunafeltz believes
in the goddess Freya, but
there are those of us that
are more seriously involved
in adoration and worship.
scripts.translation:
[芙蕾雅的信徒]
阿鲁纳菲兹的人民都信奉女神芙蕾雅，但像我们这样虔诚地崇拜、侍奉她的人并不多。

scripts.text:
[Freya's Follower]
First, there are ''Freya's
Followers,'' men and women
like me that dress in holy masks
and garments. I realize that our
dress may seem a bit peculiar
to you, but that is our way.
scripts.translation:
[芙蕾雅的信徒]
首先，是像我这样的“芙蕾雅的信徒”。
我们不分男女，都戴着神圣的面具，穿着特殊的服饰。
也许您觉得我们的装束有些奇怪，但这就是我们的习俗。

scripts.text:
[Freya's Follower]
Then, there are the Priests
who dress in clean, white
flowing robes. They work in
the temple and serve the
community as religious leaders.
scripts.translation:
[芙蕾雅的信徒]
其次，是身穿洁白飘逸长袍的牧师。
他们在神殿工作，担任宗教领袖，为民众服务。

scripts.text:
[Freya's Follower]
Among these priests are
the elite High Priests that
directly assist our pope.
They wear more colorful
clothes as a sign of their
higher status in Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[芙蕾雅的信徒]
牧师中的精英是直接辅佐教皇的高祭司。
他们的服饰更加华丽，以彰显其在拉赫的崇高地位。

scripts.text:
[Freya's Follower]
All of us work tirelessly
to bring prosperity to
Arunafeltz, and to carry
out the teachings of our
beloved goddess Freya.
scripts.translation:
[芙蕾雅的信徒]
我们都在不懈努力，为阿鲁纳菲兹带来繁荣，践行敬爱的女神芙蕾雅的教诲。

scripts.text:
[Freya's Priest]
This...
bores me...
scripts.translation:
[芙蕾雅的牧师]
这...
真无聊...

scripts.text:
[Freya's Priest]
You!
Entertain me!
scripts.translation:
[芙蕾雅的牧师]
你！
逗我开心！

scripts.text: What? You can't tell me what to do!
scripts.translation: 什么？别命令我！

scripts.text: You got it.
scripts.translation: 遵命

scripts.text:
[Freya's Priest]
Oh. That much is
true, I suppose.
scripts.translation:
[芙蕾雅的牧师]
哦，倒也是。

scripts.text:
[Freya's Priest]
Well, then,
what will you be
doing to entertain me?
scripts.translation:
[芙蕾雅的牧师]
那么，你打算怎么逗我开心？

scripts.text: Here's a funny story...
scripts.translation: 讲个有趣的故事...

scripts.text: I will do what you want me to do.
scripts.translation: 听您吩咐

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou told her the first
funny story that you
could think of.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你给她讲了你能想到的第一个有趣的故事。^000000

scripts.text:
[Freya's Priest]
That's supposed to
be funny? I suppose
that I don't understand
hoi polloi humor.
scripts.translation:
[芙蕾雅的牧师]
这也算有趣？看来我不懂普通人的幽默。

scripts.text:
[Freya's Priest]
Fine, fine~
Let me see what these
item of yours can do...
Oh? Oh! That's wonderful!
scripts.translation:
[芙蕾雅的牧师]
好吧，好吧~让我看看你的这些物品有什么好玩的...
哦？哦！太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Bard]
I've wandered this
land, singing my songs~
Searching for someone
for my heart longs~
scripts.translation:
[诗人]
我游荡在这片土地上，吟唱着歌谣~
寻找着令人心动的人~

scripts.text:
[Bard]
Can I fulfill this hope~?
Meeting the girl with
skin as white as lilies,
eyes sparkling like stars~
Yes, I'm talking about the pope~
Pope, yeah~ Pope, yeah~
scripts.translation:
[诗人]
我能实现这个愿望吗~？
遇见那位皮肤如百合般白皙，
眼睛如星辰般闪耀的女孩~
是的，我说的是教皇~
教皇，耶~ 教皇，耶~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You must be off your
rocker singing that
kind of song here
in Arunafeltz!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你居然在阿鲁纳菲兹唱这种歌，疯了吧！

scripts.text:
[Follower Akarna]
Cheshrumnir...
It is said that one
day, our goddess Freya
will descend to this place
in all of her glory. I hope
that I live to see that.
scripts.translation:
[信徒 阿卡尔纳]
瑟斯隆尼勒...
据说，总有一天，女神芙蕾雅会带着无上荣光降临此地。
真希望我能活到那一天。

scripts.text:
^3355FFShe is completely
immersed in deep,
meditative prayer.
It'd be rude to
disturb her now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF她正沉浸在冥想与祈祷之中，此时打扰她会很失礼。^000000

scripts.text:
[Follower Lekua]
Look at these flowers.
Aren't they so beautiful?
I've spent a lot of time
cultivating this flower garden.
scripts.translation:
[信徒 莱库阿]
看看这些花，漂亮吧？
我花了很多时间打理这座花园。

scripts.text:
[Follower Lekua]
I think it's Freya's
will for us to
bring as much beauty into
the world as we can. What
do you think about that?
scripts.translation:
[信徒 莱库阿]
我想，尽可能为这个世界增添美丽，就是芙蕾雅的旨意。
你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Freya's Follower]
Once again, I didn't get
any sleep yesterday... I'm
praying so hard for Freya's
second coming. I'm exhausted,
but I feel pretty good about
making that small sacrifice.
scripts.translation:
[芙蕾雅的信徒]
昨天我又没睡...
我一直在虔诚地祈祷，盼望芙蕾雅再次降临。
虽然很疲惫，但能作出这点牺牲，我还是很欣慰。

scripts.text:
[Freya's Follower]
You have done well,
my brother. I am certain
that Freya would be proud
of all your effots.
scripts.translation:
[芙蕾雅的信徒]
你做得很好，我的兄弟。
我相信，芙蕾雅一定会为你的努力感到骄傲。

scripts.text:
[Child Follower]
No! My Mingming is dead!
scripts.translation:
[孩童随从]
不！我的明明死了！

scripts.text: Mingming?
scripts.translation: 明明？

scripts.text:
[Child Follower]
Mingming is a sick bird
I found on the street, and
I really wanted it to just
rest and be healthy again
but it died! Waaaaah!
scripts.translation:
[孩童随从]
明明是我在街上捡到的一只生病的小鸟。
我本来希望它好好休息就能好起来，可它还是死了！哇啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Child Follower]
I... I'm going to
try to ask the pope!
M-maybe she can bring
Mingming back to life!
Do you know how I can
find our pope?
scripts.translation:
[孩童随从]
我...我要去问问教皇！也许她能让明明复活！
你知道怎么才能找到教皇吗？

scripts.text:
[Papaii]
Welcome to Arunafeltz,
adventurer! Enjoy your stay~
scripts.translation:
[帕帕伊]
欢迎来到阿鲁纳菲兹，冒险者！祝您玩得开心~

scripts.text: Are you a guide?
scripts.translation: 你是向导吗？

scripts.text: Thanks, have a good day.
scripts.translation: 谢谢，祝你愉快

scripts.text:
[Papaii]
Oh, actually, if you
want to speak to a guide,
head west to Rachel, and
then go north from the plaza
in the center of the city.
You'll find one over there.
scripts.translation:
[帕帕伊]
哦，要找向导的话，请先向西进入拉赫，再从市中心的广场往北走，就能找到他。

scripts.text:
[Papaii]
My name is Papaii,
and I've been sent here to
promote the upcoming festival
in honor of Freya. I encourage
you to donate for our festival
if you can spare the zeny.
scripts.translation:
[帕帕伊]
我叫帕帕伊，是来宣传即将举行的芙蕾雅庆典的。
如果您手头宽裕，希望您能捐些Zeny，支持我们的庆典。

scripts.text:
[Papaii]
If you're interested in
learning more, then please
visit our temple, which will
be accepting donations and
hosting the festival, and
speak to Priestess Nemma.
scripts.translation:
[帕帕伊]
想了解详情，请到神殿找女祭司 奈玛。
我们会在那里接受捐赠并举办庆典。

scripts.text:
[Papaii]
If you donate, you can
receive Lottery Tickets
that you can redeem for
randomly selected items from
the temple's storage. May
Freya bless you, traveler~
scripts.translation:
[帕帕伊]
捐赠后可以获得彩票，用来抽取神殿仓库里的物品。
愿芙蕾雅保佑您，旅行者~

scripts.text:
[Papaii]
May Freya bless you.
If you have time, please
visit our temple and make
a donation if you can~
scripts.translation:
[帕帕伊]
愿芙蕾雅保佑您。
有时间的话，请来神殿参观，方便的话也请捐赠一些~

scripts.text:
[Papaii]
Welcome to Arunafeltz!
The city over the rampart
is Rachel, the capital of
Arunafeltz. If you'd like to
rest from your travels, why
don't you visit Rachel?
scripts.translation:
[帕帕伊]
欢迎来到阿鲁纳菲兹！
城墙那边就是首都拉赫。
想在旅途中歇歇脚的话，不妨进去看看？

scripts.text: Are you a guide?
scripts.translation: 你是向导吗？

scripts.text: Tell me more about Rachel.
scripts.translation: 介绍一下拉赫

scripts.text:
[Papaii]
Actually, my name is
Papaii, and I'm stationed
here on behalf of the temple
spread awareness of this our
religion to visiting tourists.
scripts.translation:
[帕帕伊]
其实，我叫帕帕伊，是受神殿指派，在这里向游客介绍我们的宗教的。

scripts.text:
[Papaii]
The entire nation of
Arunafeltz worships the
goddess Freya, and most
aspects of our lives are
largely influenced by our
religion. Did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[帕帕伊]
您知道吗？阿鲁纳菲兹全国都信奉女神芙蕾雅，宗教深深影响着我们生活的方方面面。

scripts.text:
[Papaii]
I invite you to visit
our temple if you'd like
to learn more about goddess
Freya. May Freya guide you
in all that you do, and may she
protect you in your journeys!
scripts.translation:
[帕帕伊]
想进一步了解女神芙蕾雅，欢迎来神殿参观。
愿芙蕾雅指引您前行，保佑您旅途平安！

scripts.text:
[Papaii]
Welcome to Arunafeltz!
The city over the rampart
is Rachel, the capital of
Arunafeltz. If you'd like to
rest from your travels, why
don't you visit Rachel?
scripts.translation:
[帕帕伊]
欢迎来到阿鲁纳菲兹！
城墙那边就是首都拉赫。
想在旅途中歇歇脚的话，不妨进去看看？

scripts.text:
[Papaii]
Well, Rachel used to be
a barren desert until our
goddess led our ancestors to
this land. They cultivated the
desert by Freya's grace, and
made this area habitable.
scripts.translation:
[帕帕伊]
拉赫原本是一片荒芜的沙漠，直到女神引领我们的祖先来到这里。
在芙蕾雅的恩赐下，他们开垦了沙漠，让这片土地变得适宜居住。

scripts.text:
[Papaii]
Everything that you see here
has been artificially created
by humans. See? The blessings
of Freya truly enable us to
do miraculous things. You'll
see once you enter the capital.
scripts.translation:
[帕帕伊]
您在这里看到的一切，都是人们亲手建造的。
瞧，芙蕾雅的恩赐让我们创造了奇迹。
进入首都，您就会明白了。

scripts.text:
[Deno]
Although we pray to
the goddess Freya and
ask her for all sorts of
things, we can't expect
her to do everything for us.
scripts.translation:
[德诺]
我们虽然会向女神芙蕾雅祈求各种事情，却不能指望她替我们做完一切。

scripts.text:
[Deno]
As humans, it is our
responsibility to do all
in our power to conceive
our own happiness. We
believe that if it is Freya's
will, then it shall be realized.
scripts.translation:
[德诺]
作为人类，我们也有责任尽力为自己创造幸福。
我们相信，只要是芙蕾雅的旨意，就一定会实现。

scripts.text:
[Deno]
I know it might seem
a little confusing to
an outsider, the idea of
being reliant on our goddess
while relying our ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[德诺]
我知道，既依靠女神、又依靠自己的想法，对外人来说可能有些难以理解。

scripts.text:
[Lewei]
Shushh!
Be quiet.
scripts.translation:
[乐伟]
嘘！
安静点。

scripts.text:
[Lewei]
Go away! If someone!
sees you, I'm gonna
get caught, you jerk!
scripts.translation:
[乐伟]
走开！被别人看见的话，我就暴露了，你这个笨蛋！

scripts.text: What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你在做什么？

scripts.text: Alright.
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text:
[Lewei]
Hellooo~?
Can't you see?
It's called Hide-and-
Go-Seek. Gee whiz!
Hurry, get away!
scripts.translation:
[乐伟]
喂~？你看不出来吗？我在捉迷藏！真是的！
快走，快走！

scripts.text:
[Lewei]
Hurry, and get
outta here!
scripts.translation:
[乐伟]
快，赶紧离开这里！

scripts.text:
[Zhikka]
Shh! I'm playing
Hide-and-Seek. Would
you leave me alone, please?
I don't wanna get caught again!
Maybe it's because I always
use the same hiding place...
scripts.translation:
[日卡]
嘘！我在捉迷藏，别打扰我，好吗？
我可不想再被抓到了！
也许是因为我总躲在同一个地方...

scripts.text:
[Emmet]
Oh my Freya! You scared me!
I thought you were one of the
kids playing Hide-and-Seek!
Ack! Get away, get away!
Can't let them find me!
scripts.translation:
[埃米特]
芙蕾雅在上！吓死我了！我还以为你也是来捉迷藏的小孩呢！
快走，快走！不能让他们找到我！

scripts.text:
[Harse]
Where are yoooou~
Come out, come out
wherever you are~
scripts.translation:
[哈尔瑟]
你在哪呀~
出来吧，出来吧，
不管你在哪里~

scripts.text:
[Harse]
What the Freya?
What's a grown-up
doing around here?
Can't you see I'm
playing Hide-and-Go-Seek?
scripts.translation:
[哈尔瑟]
芙蕾雅在上！怎么有个大人在这里？
没看见我正在捉迷藏吗？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
You know that the temple
in Rachel is accepting
donations? They're asking
for a lot of zeny, but my buddies
and I donated anyway. Heck, we
wanted to see what we could win~
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
听说了吗？拉赫的神殿正在接受捐赠。
虽然要捐不少Zeny，我和朋友们还是捐了。
嘿，我们也想看看能抽到什么~

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
One of my buddies was
real freakin' lucky. He
got some kind of album,
opened it up and found
some kinda card inside.
Really pretty stuff.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
我有个朋友，运气好得不得了！他抽到一本册子，打开一看，里面居然有张卡片。
真漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Another buddy of mine?
Not so lucky. He got a
Condensed White Potion...
Yeah, I don't blame him for
feeling a little gypped, but he
donated for a good cause, right?
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
另一个朋友就没这么好运了，只抽到一瓶白色纤细药水...
他觉得亏了，我也能理解，不过捐钱毕竟是做好事，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Me? I got some yellow
bell shaped fruit. I didn't
really feel like eating it,
but after I took a bite,
it was like... whoa.
So refreshing!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
我嘛，抽到一种黄色的、像铃铛一样的水果。
本来没什么胃口，可咬了一口后，哇...
真清爽！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Anyway, all the donations
will be used to fund some
kinda festival. Sooo, I don't
think they'll be holding this
special lottery anymore once
they get enough money, you know?
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
总之，捐款都会用来筹办庆典。
等钱筹够了，我想这次特别抽奖也就结束了，你说呢？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
You know, one of the
priestesses at the temple
in Rachel looked troubled
for some reason. I should've
asked what was bothering her,
and offered my help. Mm, nah.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
拉赫神殿里有位女祭司，不知道为什么，一副很苦恼的样子。
我本该问问她遇到了什么麻烦，帮帮她的。
嗯，还是算了。
